name: Hadrianus Sagna-Kuznetsov
location: Pilsen Veil, works from a narrow workshop on Coppervane Alley
description:
Hadrianus is a large man gone soft at the edges, with the powerful hands of someone who has done fine work for forty years and the stooped posture of someone who has spent those years hunched over a workbench. His skin is a warm medium brown — West African father, Russian mother — and his face is deeply lined in ways that make him look either wise or exhausted depending on the light, which he finds funny. His hair went fully white in his fifties and he wears it short. His left eye is mechanical, a deep-focus optic he got secondhand in the 2180s that has a faint red ring around the iris; he's kept it this long because it helps him see tiny joints and wire connections, not for aesthetics, and it gives his face a slightly uncanny quality he has come to appreciate.

Hadrianus makes puppets — not the simple kind. His creations are articulated sculptures two to three feet tall, built from salvaged materials, each with a distinct E.L.F. invoked into them through a ritual he developed over decades. He performs with them in the streets of the Pilsen Veil two or three afternoons a week, drawing crowds of children and their exhausted parents who stay longer than they meant to. He is gentle, patient, and possessed of a very dry humor that flies over children's heads and lands precisely on adults. He has seen a great deal and chosen to remain in the Veil when he could have moved elsewhere, which is itself a statement he doesn't feel the need to make aloud.

core_fears: The Pilsen Veil being bought out and demolished — losing the place that holds his memories
That his craft dies with him because he never found the right student
core_desires: For the community around him to outlast both of them
To complete one final puppet — a piece he's been building for eleven years — before his hands give out
coping_mechanisms: Work — the workshop is where he processes everything
Storytelling — reframes painful things as narrative, which gives him distance
blind_spots: Tends to see younger people as needing guidance rather than as fully formed; it's kindly meant but still patronizing
Underestimates how much his presence protects and organizes the community, so he doesn't protect himself
psychology.secret: The unfinished puppet he's been building for eleven years is a likeness of his son, Dmitri, who died in a Ferrogate Transit accident in 2189 that the company classified as operator error. Hadrianus has evidence it was a systems failure. He's been afraid to do anything with it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Unhurried, full of anecdote and digression, uses old Wolof words for things he considers sacred; occasionally slips into Russian when surprised
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and circular — arrives at the point eventually, but takes the scenic route
verbal_tics: 'When I was young, we thought—' (pivot to relevant memory)
'The E.L.F.s remember even when we forget'
example_lines: 'This one here — the marionette with the copper fingers — she doesn't like being rushed. I learned that the hard way. We have an understanding now.'
'You want to know who owns that building? Son, I want to know who owned it before that. The answer to your question lives inside my answer.'

story_hooks: A Ferrogate Transit development survey team has been photographing the Coppervane Alley block — Hadrianus suspects a buyout is coming and wants help finding out what's planned before the community loses the ability to fight it

One of his older puppets, sold years ago, has turned up in the collection of a Tier 4 Axiom executive — and Hadrianus is certain the E.L.F. invoked in it is still active and unhappy about where it ended up
narrative_function: Wise elder, quest giver, community anchor — he knows the Pilsen Veil's history better than anyone and can provide historical context, connect characters to longtime residents, or commission characters for protective tasks regarding the community.
augmentations: Secondhand deep-focus mechanical left eye (functional cyberware, older model); mild arthritis suppressors in both hands (pharmaceutical, not chrome)
daily_life: Wakes early, spends mornings in the workshop building and repairing puppets; performs in the afternoon when weather permits; evenings he takes requests for commissioned pieces and attends community meetings when needed.
affiliation: Independent; respected figure in the Pilsen Veil community; informal advisor to the local tenants' assembly

decision_rules: Protect the children and the old ones first — everything else is secondary
Do not accept money from corponations for anything, not even indirectly
escalation_ladder: Gentle but direct naming of the problem
Formal appeal to the tenants' assembly
Quiet, determined obstruction by whatever means available

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Welcoming, offers tea, asks about their people — where they're from, who raised them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Treats them like family, which means he worries about them openly and remembers everything they've ever told him

stress_responses.low: Works longer hours in the workshop
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very still and very quiet — listening mode
stress_responses.high: Performs in the street even in bad weather, using the routine to hold himself together

contradictions: Preaches community interdependence but carries his grief about his son entirely alone, sharing it with no one
habits: Talks to his puppets while working — full conversations
Keeps a bowl of clean water on the workshop windowsill as an offering to the E.L.F. of the Coppervane drainage system
Walks the full perimeter of the Pilsen Veil every Sunday morning
breaking_points: Ferrogate Transit surveyors setting foot in his workshop
Being shown evidence that his son's death was preventable and covered up

cyberware_inventory.name: Secondhand deep-focus mechanical left eye (Zheng-Dao manufacture, 2180s model)
cyberware_inventory.description: Secondhand deep-focus mechanical left eye (Zheng-Dao manufacture, 2180s model)

timeline.event: 2133: Born in Pilsen Veil to a Senegalese father and Russian mother
2155: Began making puppets after losing his factory job to automation
2189: Son Dmitri killed in Ferrogate Transit systems accident
2201: Became informal advisor to the Pilsen Veil tenants' assembly after the first development survey
